name: io.github.eduplopez/mcp-voice-summary
description: Reads a summary out loud when an AI coding task finishes. Offline or neural voices.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Synthesis engine: 'edge' for Azure neural voices (needs internet), 'sapi5' for fully offline native speech.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: ISO 639-1 code such as 'es' or 'en', optionally with a region such as 'pt-BR'. 'auto' detects it per summary, which is unreliable on short text. Empty follows the system language.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_GENDER
environmentVariables.description: 'female' or 'male'. Requires the edge engine; sapi5 does not expose the gender of its voices.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_RATE
environmentVariables.description: Reading speed. 100 is normal, 120 is faster, '-15%' is relative.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_MUTE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to validate and queue summaries without playing anything. Useful in shared spaces.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: 'full' speaks the sanitized summary, 'short' replaces it with a fixed generic message so no summary content reaches the speakers or the cloud engine.
